title: Op
description:
FROZEN INTERFACE #2a — a single validated mutation of the RSG.

The model emits INTENT: {target, relation, anchor}. It never emits coordinates, because it cannot see. The client's solver turns intent into a pose, writes the result into `constraint_report`, and hands that back so the model can narrate what actually happened.

Every op carries its own `inverse`. That is what makes undo exact rather than approximate: UNDO is not a recomputation, it is the replay of a pre-computed op.

Idempotency: `op_id` is a client-generated ULID. Applying the same op_id twice is a no-op, so a duplicated tool call from the model cannot double-move anything.

op_id.description: ULID, generated on the client. Lexicographically sortable by creation time. Idempotency key.

seq.description: Monotonic within `branch_id`, starting at 0. A gap means a dropped op — the client should refuse to apply and resync.

branch_id.description: Op log branch. Undoing past a fork point and editing again starts a new branch instead of destroying history.

target_ids.description: Entity ids this op mutates. Validated against live RSG ids BEFORE apply — any unknown id drops the whole op client-side. This is the hallucination guard.

inverse.description: The op that exactly reverses this one. Computed by the applier at apply time, never by the model. Null ONLY for type=UNDO (undoing an undo is a redo, which is a new op against the branch). An OpCore rather than a full Op because an inverse needs no envelope — applying it mints a fresh op_id, seq, and its own inverse.

constraint_report.description: Filled in by the solver at apply time. Null on an op that has been created but not yet applied.

client_ts.description: Epoch milliseconds when the client minted the op. Together with applied_ts this is the on-device half of the sub-1.2s budget.

applied_ts.description: Epoch milliseconds when the op landed in the graph. Null until applied.

OpCore.title: OpCore
OpCore.description: The applicable payload of an op with no envelope: enough to mutate the graph, not enough to log. Used for `inverse`.

PlacementRelation.title: PlacementRelation
PlacementRelation.description: How the target should sit relative to `anchor_id`. This is the model's entire vocabulary for position — it has no others.

OpParams.title: OpParams
OpParams.description:
Union of every op type's parameters, flattened. Every field is nullable and each is meaningful for only some `type` values — the table below is the contract. A field set for the wrong type is ignored by the applier, not an error.

MOVE_OBJECT      relation, anchor_id, side, offset_m, position (relation=absolute only)
ROTATE_OBJECT    yaw, yaw_delta, face_anchor_id
RESIZE_OBJECT    dimensions, scale
DELETE_OBJECT    (none; the inverse carries `object`)
ADD_OBJECT       object OR catalog_id, plus relation/anchor_id for placement
REPLACE_OBJECT   catalog_id, keep_pose
CHANGE_MATERIAL  material_ref
CHANGE_COLOR     color_hex
APPLY_STYLE      theme, style_batch_id
MODIFY_WALL      surface_state, material_ref, surface (inverse only)
MODIFY_FLOOR     surface_state, material_ref, surface (inverse only)
UNDO             undo_op_id

anchor_id.description: Entity the relation is measured against. Validated against live RSG ids like target_ids.

side.description: Disambiguates `beside`. Left/right are from the CAMERA's point of view at utterance time, resolved on-device before the op is built.
side.title: PlacementSide

offset_m.description: Requested gap for `beside` / `in_front_of`. The solver may grow this to satisfy clearances; it may not shrink it below 0.

position.description: Room-space [x,y,z]. ONLY valid with relation=absolute, which only the client and the style planner emit — never the voice model.

yaw_delta.description: Relative yaw, radians. Mutually exclusive with `yaw`.

face_anchor_id.description: Rotate so the object's front faces this entity. Resolved to an absolute yaw by the solver.

object.description: Full object snapshot. Set on ADD_OBJECT, and on the inverse of DELETE_OBJECT — this is how a delete is undone exactly rather than re-derived.

surface.description: Full surface snapshot, for the inverse of MODIFY_WALL / MODIFY_FLOOR.

catalog_id.description: Key into catalog/manifest.json. The asset is already in the app bundle; nothing is fetched.

keep_pose.description: REPLACE_OBJECT: reuse the old object's pose instead of re-solving. Default true.

style_batch_id.description: Groups the <=12 ops one APPLY_STYLE expanded into, so a single undo reverses the whole theme.

undo_op_id.description: UNDO: the op_id being reversed. The applier looks it up and applies its stored `inverse`.

CausedBy.title: CausedBy
CausedBy.description: Provenance. Every op traces to something a human did — this is what makes the session recorder diffable when a turn misfires once in ten runs.

utterance_id.description: Groups ops from one turn. Ops sharing an utterance_id undo together.

transcript.description: What the user actually said, verbatim. Empty string for non-voice sources.
